messages.content: How do Urho3D nodes and components work?

Scene graph: Scene → Node → Node → ... Each Node has position, rotation, scale, children.
Components attach to Nodes: node->CreateComponent<StaticModel>(). Components are the behavior — Node is the container.
Key components: StaticModel (mesh), AnimatedModel (skeletal), RigidBody (physics), CollisionShape, Light, Camera, SoundSource3D, LogicComponent (custom update).
Create node: scene->CreateChild("Name"). LOCAL flag = client-only, not replicated.
Find: scene->GetChild("Name", true) for recursive search. GetComponent<T>() on a node.
How do Urho3D vectors and math work?

Vector3: x_, y_, z_. Operators: +, -, *, /. Methods: Length(), Normalized(), DotProduct(v), CrossProduct(v).
Vector2: x_, y_. Used for UV, screen coords, 2D positions.
Quaternion: rotation. FromAngleAxis(angle, axis), FromRotationTo(from, to), Slerp(target, t).
Matrix3x4: transform. SetTranslation/Rotation/Scale.
MathDefs.h: Lerp, Clamp, Min, Max, Random, Abs, Sign, IsNaN.
Constants: Vector3::ZERO, Vector3::ONE, Vector3::UP, Vector3::FORWARD, Quaternion::IDENTITY.
Angles: Urho uses degrees for user-facing, radians internally where noted.
How does Urho3D ResourceCache work?

auto* cache = GetSubsystem<ResourceCache>();
cache->GetResource<Model>("Models/Weapons/Sword.mdl") — loads or returns cached.
cache->GetResource<Material>("Materials/Stone.xml")
cache->GetResource<XMLFile>("UI/DefaultStyle.xml")
cache->GetResource<Font>("Fonts/Anonymous Pro.ttf")
cache->GetResource<Texture2D>("Textures/Terrain.png")
cache->GetResource<JSONFile>("DrivenKeys/campfire_burn.json")
cache->GetResource<ParticleEffect>("Particle/Fire.xml")

Resource paths are relative to bin/ or set via -pp flag.
AddManualResource() for runtime-generated resources.
GetResourceDirs() returns search paths.
How does Urho3D event system work?
How does Urho3D rendering work?

Renderer subsystem: GetSubsystem<Renderer>().
Viewport: new Viewport(context_, scene, camera). renderer->SetViewport(0, viewport).
Materials: XML files. Reference techniques, textures, shader parameters.
Techniques: define passes (base, lit, alpha). Reference shaders.
Shaders: GLSL in bin/CoreData/Shaders/GLSL/. Compiled to SPIR-V for Vulkan.
StaticModel: SetModel(model), SetMaterial(mat). SetCastShadows(true/false).
AnimatedModel: SetModel + SetAnimation. Plays skeletal animations.
Light: directional, point, spot. SetColor, SetBrightness, SetRange.
Zone: ambient color, fog. GetSubsystem<Renderer>()->GetDefaultZone().
Render paths: Forward (default), Deferred (RenderPaths/Deferred.xml).
How does Urho3D UI system work?

UI subsystem: GetSubsystem<UI>(). Root: ui->GetRoot().
Style: uiRoot->SetDefaultStyle(cache->GetResource<XMLFile>("UI/DefaultStyle.xml")).
Elements: Text, Button, LineEdit, ListView, DropDownList, Window, ScrollView, Slider, CheckBox.
Create: auto* btn = parent->CreateChild<Button>("Name"). btn->SetStyleAuto().
Layout: SetPosition, SetSize, or anchors: SetMinAnchor(0,0), SetMaxAnchor(1,1) for responsive.
Anchors: normalized coords (0-1). Propagated on resize via PropagateParentResize().
Events: E_RELEASED (button click), E_TEXTFINISHED (enter in LineEdit), E_ITEMSELECTED (dropdown).
Font: text->SetFont(font, size). Fonts in bin/Data/Fonts/.
Wordwrap: text->SetWordwrap(true). SetMaxWidth for wrap boundary.
How does Urho3D physics work?

Bullet physics via PhysicsWorld component on Scene.
RigidBody: node->CreateComponent<RigidBody>(). SetMass(1.0f) for dynamic, 0 for static.
CollisionShape: node->CreateComponent<CollisionShape>(). SetBox/SetSphere/SetCapsule/SetTriangleMesh.
Raycast: physicsWorld->RaycastSingle(ray, maxDist, result). Returns position, normal, drawable.
Gravity: physicsWorld->SetGravity(Vector3(0, -9.81f, 0)).
Forces: body->ApplyForce(force), ApplyImpulse(impulse), SetLinearVelocity(v).
Collision events: E_PHYSICSCOLLISION, E_NODECOLLISION.
Terrain collision: terrain node gets RigidBody(mass=0) + CollisionShape::SetTerrain().
How does Urho3D audio work?

Audio subsystem: GetSubsystem<Audio>().
SoundSource: node->CreateComponent<SoundSource>() for 2D. SoundSource3D for positional.
Play: soundSource->Play(cache->GetResource<Sound>("Sounds/Effect.ogg")).
Listener: node->CreateComponent<SoundListener>(). audio->SetListener(listener).
3D attenuation: soundSource3D->SetNearDistance(1), SetFarDistance(50).
Looping: soundSource->SetAutoRemoveMode(REMOVE_DISABLED) + sound->SetLooped(true).
Gain: soundSource->SetGain(0.5f). Master: audio->SetMasterGain(SOUND_EFFECT, 0.8f).
Formats: .ogg (Vorbis), .wav. OGG preferred for size.
How does Urho3D networking work?

Network subsystem: GetSubsystem<Network>().
Server: network->StartServer(port). Client: network->Connect(address, port, scene).
Replication: nodes with CreateMode::REPLICATED auto-sync. LOCAL nodes are client-only.
Delta updates: only changed attributes sent. MSG_NODEDELTAUPDATE, MSG_COMPONENTDELTAUPDATE.
Custom messages: connection->SendMessage(msgID, reliable, inOrder, buffer).
Receive: SubscribeToEvent(E_NETWORKMESSAGE, handler). Read msgID, data from VariantMap.
Remote events: network->RegisterRemoteEvent(eventHash). Send via node->SendRemoteEvent().
VectorBuffer for packing: WriteU16, WriteFloat, WriteString. MemoryBuffer for unpacking.
How does Urho3D file I/O work?

FileSystem: GetSubsystem<FileSystem>().
File exists: fs->FileExists(path). Dir exists: fs->DirExists(path).
Create dir: fs->CreateDir(path).
Read: File file(context_, path, FILE_READ). file.ReadString(), file.ReadFloat(), file.GetSize().
Write: File file(context_, path, FILE_WRITE). file.WriteString(), file.WriteLine().
System command: fs->SystemCommand(cmd) — synchronous, blocks.
Temp dir: fs->GetTemporaryDir().
NEVER use fopen, std::ifstream, or raw POSIX. Always use Urho3D File/FileSystem — cross-platform.
How do Urho3D materials and shaders work?

Material XML: <material><technique name="Techniques/Diff.xml"/><texture unit="diffuse" name="Textures/Stone.png"/><parameter name="MatDiffColor" value="1 1 1 1"/></material>
Clone: SharedPtr<Material> mat = original->Clone(). Modify clone without affecting original.
Set param at runtime: mat->SetShaderParameter("MatDiffColor", Color(1,0,0,1)).
Technique: defines render passes and which shaders to use.
Shaders: GLSL in CoreData/Shaders/GLSL/. Vertex + fragment pairs.
Vulkan: GLSL compiled to SPIR-V via shaderc/glslang at runtime.
Custom shader params: SetShaderParameter("MyParam", value) — accessible as uniform in GLSL.
How does Urho3D animation work?

AnimatedModel: node->CreateComponent<AnimatedModel>(). SetModel(model).
Play: animModel->GetAnimationState("Walk") or AddAnimationState(anim).
AnimationState: SetWeight(1.0), SetLooped(true), SetTime(t), AddTime(dt).
Blending: multiple states with weights. SetLayer(n) for priority.
Bone access: Skeleton& skel = animModel->GetSkeleton(). skel.GetBone("RightHand").
Bone node: bone.node_ — attach props, read world transform.
Text keys: .json sidecar next to .ani. Fire E_ANIMATIONTEXTKEY at marked frames.
Animation files: .ani format. Created by AssetTool from FBX.
How does Urho3D serialization work?

Scene save/load: scene->SaveXML(file) / scene->LoadXML(file).
Component attributes: URHO3D_ACCESSOR_ATTRIBUTE("Name", Get, Set, default, mode).
AM_DEFAULT = serialize + network replicate. AM_FILE = serialize only.
Node vars: node->SetVar(hash, value) — arbitrary key-value on any node. Replicated if node is REPLICATED.
XML resources: pugixml underneath. XMLFile, XMLElement.
JSON: JSONFile, JSONValue for modern data.
Binary: VectorBuffer/MemoryBuffer for network messages.
All serialization goes through Urho3D APIs — never raw file I/O.
